transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for being here. You all know the situation — we've got Uncle's 16-foot wooden rowboat sitting on sawhorses beside my house, and we need to figure out what to do with it before the rainy season hits. I'll be making the final call on whether we keep it, where it's stored, how we prep it, and when it first goes out. But before I decide anything, I want to hear from each of you. Is there anything I should know — concerns, ideas, constraints, anything that ought to affect this decision? Go ahead and lay it out, and I'll take it all in before we settle on a plan.
